# openmetadata_directory (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata drive directory by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_directory" "reports" {
  fully_qualified_name = "google-drive.root.reports"
}

output "reports_directory_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_directory.reports.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Directory fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Directory UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) Directory name.
- `parent` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent directory, when there is one.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent drive service.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
